title: Waving bye-bye is on the first-birthday checklist
summary: Most children wave bye-bye by about 1 year, the US CDC says.
body: CDC's communication milestones for 1 year include waving bye-bye. The page says most children, meaning 75 percent or more, do the listed items by that birthday. A wave is a conventional goodbye gesture, learned in company, not a word count. The program says its materials are not a substitute for a validated screen and not a diagnosis. A textbook range for answering a request to wave is a different claim, and other countries' charts differ.
